purpose: One bounded synthetic design-tradeoff panel within the physical-evidence journey
load_semantics: Selected-load temperatures are constant-property linear arithmetic Tin + Q/G. The fixed 60 W combined-fault design criterion stays visible and unchanged when the selected display load is 40 or 80 W.

scatter.warning: The sole scoped Pareto candidate still fails the fixed 60 W combined-fault criterion. Pareto is not feasibility or a global optimum.

branch_flow_bars.pressure_warning: Open-branch flow is unchanged by sealing at the same pressure. Comparing 25 Pa nominal to 15 Pa combined reduces open-branch flow to 0.6 times nominal because pressure also changes.

flag_ownership.raw_mass_temperature_criterion_pass_at_6: Two synthetic criteria only; can be true outside Reynolds scope
flag_ownership.Reynolds_qualified_conditional_pass_at_6: Criteria plus saved numerical gates and the declared Reynolds cutoff, still conditional on omitted physics
flag_ownership.heat_load_records.selected_scenario_cond: Condition at selected display load and case, never redefines the fixed design requirement
flag_ownership.fixed_60W_combined_criterion.Reynolds_qu: Authoritative fixed synthetic design result, false for all nine candidates

required_labels: Synthetic 85°C uniform-base ceiling and 40 g fin-only aluminum budget
Ideal fixed-pressure straight-channel source; entrance, exit and hydrodynamic developing losses omitted
Fin-only mass excludes base, duct, fan, motor and aircraft
Hydraulic dissipation is not electrical fan power
Constant-property model; high failed temperatures are extrapolations
Material and model-form scenarios are separate from pass flags and are not confidence bounds
Research screening only; no aircraft validation
